title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Company**
-----------


NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control.


Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading.

**Role Description**
--------------------


NestAI builds the software and intelligence layer for autonomous defense systems, deployed in live operational environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have — it's the whole point. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll own the technical delivery and integration of that platform for our most critical partners.


This is not a traditional implementation or support role. It's a high-stakes, high-ownership full-stack engineering position: you'll build, adapt, and scale modern web applications, decision-support interfaces, and backend integration layers directly against complex customer environments — with the freedom to choose the right tool for the problem rather than inherit a decade of someone else's legacy decisions.


We need a versatile engineer who can jump into unfamiliar codebases, connect disparate software ecosystems, and deliver intuitive, high-performance user experiences where software meets the mission. Most of what you encounter here won't have a known answer yet; you'll work it out alongside a small, senior team that has full ownership of the problems in front of it, and a product organization that takes field feedback seriously enough to ship it back into the platform in days, not quarters.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

* **Mission-specific full stack engineering:** Take technical ownership of building, customizing, and deploying client-facing web applications, operational dashboards, and backend services.
* **API & system integration:** Design, develop, and deploy robust APIs and backend services that connect NestOS cloud and edge modules with external situational awareness and command systems.
* **Frontend execution:** Build responsive, high-performance decision-support UI designed for low-latency, mission-critical operational environments.
* **Engineering craft under pressure:** Hold a high bar for code quality, testing, and observability even while moving fast on-site.
* **AI-driven workflows:** Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate velocity and rapidly prototype client-requested features without sacrificing platform security or reliability.
* **Collaborative problem solving:** Work directly with customer technical teams and internal product R&D to translate operational user needs into scalable full-stack features, feeding field feedback back into our core product roadmap.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Solid experience (equivalent to 5+ years) as a Full Stack Software Engineer, with a proven track record of shipping complex web applications and backend systems.
* Strong proficiency across the full web stack, including modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript) and server-side ecosystems (Node.js, Python, or Go).
* Practical experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and WebSockets, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment pipelines across cloud or on-prem environments.
* A quick study who adapts rapidly to new technical environments, diverse codebases, and shifting customer priorities — you thrive on changing scenery rather than needing a settled, well-trodden stack.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interface directly with external partners, understand user workflows, and translate complex operational needs into software realities.
* Willingness to travel to and work in customer environments as needed.

**Preferred, not required:**

* Experience in client-facing technical delivery or technical consulting.
* Prior exposure to mapping/GIS libraries (e.g., Mapbox, Cesium) or data visualization.
* Experience in defence or aerospace environments.


If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box.

**Why join NestAI**
-------------------


At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship.


If you want to build with purpose - and with leading experts in the field - you’ve come to the right place.

**Practicalities**
------------------


Employment is subject to applicable security screening.


NestAI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
**Description**
---------------


**They say, “it’s not rocket science.” We disagree.**
  

  

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
  

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.
  

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
  

  

We are now looking for an AWS DevOps Engineer who will build and improve the infrastructure and deployment workflows that support our systems. Working across AWS and on-premises environments, you will help developers deliver software reliably, strengthen security through automated controls and make our systems easier to operate and monitor.
**Requirements**
----------------


We are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems through automation and takes ownership of system reliability. You work well across IT and development teams, share your knowledge and look for ways to make everyday operations better.
  

  

**You bring:**  

* At least three years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments.
* Practical experience with infrastructure as code, using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or Jenkins.
* Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in cloud or on-premises environments.
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

  

Experience with Ansible or similar configuration management tools, scripting in Python or Bash, and DevSecOps practices is an advantage.
  

  

Swedish citizenship is required for this role.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


You will work closely with developers, architects and IT colleagues to improve how we build, deploy and manage our environments.
  

  

**Your responsibilities include:**  

* Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation, and automate configuration with Ansible.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based systems and applications.
* Automate deployments and environment provisioning to improve consistency and reduce manual work.
* Manage containerized workloads in Amazon EKS and on-premises Kubernetes environments.
* Develop monitoring and observability across cloud and on-premises resources using Grafana and application performance monitoring tools.
* Investigate operational incidents and improve reliability through testing, automation and lessons learned.
* Build security policies and automated guardrails into infrastructure and deployment workflows.
* Manage software artefacts and container images using Amazon ECR and JFrog, supporting a secure software supply chain.
* Contribute to solution design, quality assurance and clear documentation of infrastructure and processes for internal use and audits.
**Benefits**
------------


**We offer you**  

* A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
* An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
* An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

You will work with colleagues across engineering and IT, develop your skills across cloud and on-premises environments, and contribute to how we build and operate our systems.
  

  

**Additional benefits**  

* In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
* Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

  

**Location**  

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna Strand.
  

  

**Further information**  

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:
  

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com
  

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com
  

  

**Next Step**
  

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.
  

You can submit your application up until 2026-11-29 which is the latest possible date for consideration. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.
  

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.
  

  

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.
  

  

**We help Earth benefit from Space**  

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
  

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
   

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Senior Change Manager (OCM)
description:
**About Justera Group**  

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Change Manager (Organisational Change Management – OCM) to support major IT transformation initiatives across European operations. The role will focus on driving organisational readiness, stakeholder engagement, user adoption and sustainable change across multiple countries.


The successful candidate will support key transformation programmes, including a Salesforce Service Cloud transformation, service process rollouts, and Transportation Management System (TMS) implementation. You will work closely with project teams, business stakeholders and end users to ensure smooth transitions, effective adoption of new systems and processes, and successful delivery of change initiatives.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Change Strategy and Planning:** Develop and implement change management strategies, roadmaps and plans aligned with project objectives and business priorities.
* **Change Impact Assessment:** Identify and assess the impact of new systems, processes and organisational changes on business functions, stakeholders and end users.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Identify key stakeholders, manage stakeholder relationships and develop engagement strategies to ensure alignment and commitment throughout the transformation.
* **Communication Management:** Design and coordinate communication plans to ensure timely, clear and consistent messaging across European teams and business units.
* **Training and User Enablement:** Coordinate training needs assessments, training materials, learning activities and user enablement initiatives to support effective adoption of new systems and processes.
* **Go-Live Readiness and Hypercare:** Support business readiness assessments, go-live planning, post-implementation hypercare and continuous improvement activities.
* **Adoption and Change Effectiveness:** Define and monitor adoption KPIs, gather user feedback, measure change effectiveness and recommend corrective actions where required.
* **Project Coordination:** Coordinate change-related deliverables, effort estimates, resource requirements, dependencies and timelines in collaboration with project managers and implementation teams.
* **Multi-Country Rollouts:** Support the implementation of standardised processes and systems across multiple European markets while considering local business requirements and cultural differences.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve change management practices, user experience and long-term adoption of new technologies and ways of working.

 **Requirements:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Organisational Change Management (OCM), preferably within IT transformation or digital transformation programmes.
* Proven experience developing and executing change management strategies, impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills.
* Experience coordinating training, user enablement and organisational readiness activities.
* Experience supporting IT system implementations, business process changes and multi-country rollouts.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, business users and technical delivery teams.
* Strong planning, coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.
* Analytical mindset with experience tracking adoption metrics, collecting feedback and assessing change effectiveness.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote, international project environment.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud transformation or rollout programmes is a significant advantage.
* Experience in customer service transformation, CRM implementations or service process optimisation.
* Exposure to Transportation Management System (TMS) implementation or logistics transformation initiatives.
* Experience working within large-scale, cross-functional IT transformation programmes.
* Familiarity with change management frameworks and methodologies such as Prosci ADKAR or Kotter's Change Model.

**Contract and Availability**

* Freelance / B2B engagement.
* Remote working arrangement based in Sweden.
* Availability during European business hours.
* Immediate availability is preferred.
* Willingness to travel within Europe approximately 10% of the time.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Service Delivery Manager – Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
Solna, Sweden


* Full-time


* Delivery, Project and Product Management


* Onsite


* Tieto Caretech

  
Job Description  

  

**At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**

  

**About us**


Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We put citizens and patients at the center, simplifying everyday life for all, and providing the tools required to transition towards increased self-and preventive care and lower cost-of-care settings.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

  

**About the role**


At Tieto Caretech’s Data Driven Care unit we are reshaping healthcare and social care services by providing our customers with data-driven solutions. Our team consists of high-end professionals working in platform development, data science, data engineering, data modelling, cloud solutions, security and software development.


We are a growing international team of talented, continuously improving experts. With us you get to work with latest technologies, innovative new solutions and create wellbeing for the society.


As a **Service Delivery Manager** in our team, we expect you to have a strong will to lead data-driven service deliveries in complex technology environment and bring new value to our customers through pioneering solutions. To succeed in this position, you need to have previous experience in service deliveries in area of data-driven solutions.

  

**In this role you will be responsible for:**


* Leading service deliveries and act as a key contact person towards customers
* Your focus will be in service deliveries in Swedish- and German-speaking European markets
* Ensuring the success of our customers in their operations with our deliveries
* Continuous development of our operations together with colleagues in delivery management, product management and development teams
* Building relationships inside the organization to promote active collaboration
  

**To succeed in this role, you should have:**


* Service delivery management experience of data centric solutions.
* Fluent ITIL knowledge.
* Fluency in Swedish and/or German, as well as English, is required for this role.
* Experience of data platforms and cloud environments
* Experience of healthcare industry
  

**As a person you:**


* Have a capability to lead technically complex service deliveries with multiple teams and stakeholders
* Have a will to bring new value to society via new revolutionary health and care solutions
* Demonstrate a positive can-do attitude
* Are self-motivated, yet an active team player
* Take pride in coaching and inspiring your colleagues
  

  

**AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

  

**What’s in it for you?**


What’s in it for you? With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

  

**Did we get you inspired?**


We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Hannu Tissari (hannu.t.tissari@tieto.com).  

  



*We perform background checks on all final candidates.*


*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

  

  

Additional Information  

  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto


**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**

title: Head of Technical Accounting & Reporting
description:
**TL;DR:** We're looking for someone to own technical accounting and reporting at Lovable as we build toward being a generational company. You'll be the person who works out the right US GAAP answer on the questions that matter, writes it down so an auditor can rely on it, and turns it into reporting that would stand up to scrutiny. You'll report to our Group Financial Controller. This is a builder's role: there is a lot to set up, and you'll do much of it yourself.

**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**The role**


Lovable's business model raises real accounting questions. We sell subscriptions and usage-based credits to millions of self-serve users and to enterprise customers, through our own billing, app stores and payment processors. We buy a lot of AI compute. We have US, Swedish and UK entities and we report under US GAAP. Most of these questions have been answered at a point in time. They need proper answers, written down, and kept current as the business changes, without slowing the business down to get there.


You'll own that. Stock-based compensation, leases, LLM commitments, consolidation and foreign currency, M&A accounting and whatever comes next as we launch new products and features. You'll own the accounting policies, the position papers and the relationship with our auditors on technical matters.


You'll also own external reporting: building the financial statements, disclosures and reporting calendar we'll need as a public company, well before we need them, and doing it in a way that is as automated as possible. We expect you to leverage AI to draft disclosures, tie out numbers and flag changes. You'll decide where that's safe and where a person has to own the judgment.


You'll report to our Group Financial Controller, and work closely with our head of Revenue Accounting and our Chief Accounting Officer, on the significant judgments.

**What we’re looking for**

**Must have**

* Deep US GAAP expertise, with ASC 842 for leases and ASC 718 for Stock Based Compensation as a strength. You've written position papers that auditors have accepted on complex matters.
* Big 4 background, ideally including exposure to national office, accounting advisory or SEC reporting work, followed by in-house experience at a technology company.
* Has built or materially upgraded an external reporting process: financial statements, disclosures, tie-outs and the calendar behind them.
* Can explain a complex accounting conclusion to an engineer or a product manager in plain English, and change their mind when the facts warrant it.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building an AI first function from the ground up.
* Pragmatic about applying accounting guidance to minimize operational overhead.

**Nice to have**

* Has operated in a hypergrowth environment, including ideally through an IPO or the first year as a public company, ie. S-1 or 10-K preparation and SOX implementation.
* Experience with AI, cloud or consumption-based business models and their revenue and cost accounting.
* Experience with IFRS and Swedish or UK statutory reporting.
* Has leveraged AI tools to draft disclosures, research guidance or automate tie-outs, and has views on where they help and where they're dangerous.

**This role isn't for you if**

* You want a team and an established process on day one.
* You prefer to be asked for an opinion rather than go and find the questions yourself.
* You'd rather write a perfect memo in 2 weeks than a good answer in two hours.
* You see AI as a threat to technical accounting rather than a tool for doing it better.

**What you’ll do**

* Own technical accounting at Lovable: research the questions, reach a defensible US GAAP conclusion, and write position papers that hold up with auditors.
* Own technical accounting for AI compute and cost of revenue, stock-based compensation, leases, consolidation and foreign currency, and any new areas as they arise.
* Write and maintain the accounting policy manual, and make sure the close team is applying it consistently.
* Build the external reporting function: US GAAP consolidated financial statements, footnote disclosures, a reporting calendar and tie-out process that would meet public-company standards.
* Own local statutory accounting and reporting for our Swedish and UK entities, ensuring the books comply with Swedish GAAP (K3) and UK GAAP (FRS 102), including local GAAP adjustments, statutory financial statements and reconciliations to US GAAP.
* Collaborate with the wider accounting team reviewing the month-end close figures to ensure any adjustments are identified promptly and remediation measures put in place.
* Be the point person coordinating the external audit: present significant judgments, new standards, complex transactions and prepare future audit committee-facing materials.
* Assess new accounting standards and SEC requirements and plan our adoption.
* Leverage AI tooling to draft, tie out and review, and set the standard for where human judgment is required.
* Drive public-company readiness across accounting and reporting, including disclosure controls and SOX requirements.

**About your application**


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.


We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

**BID Manager Public 360° - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**


**About Public 360°**


Public 360° is a leading Nordic platform for modern case and document management. We help public-sector organisations create more connected processes, improve decision support and simplify everyday work for employees and citizens.


Public 360° is part of Tieto, a Nordic software and digitalisation company. Here, you will become part of a highly skilled environment where technology, the public sector and commercial development come together.  

  



**Shape winning proposals. Navigate complexity. Help us grow in the Swedish public sector.**


Winning business in the public sector is rarely about one great sales pitch. It takes strategy, structure, collaboration and a strong understanding of public procurement.


We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded **BID Manager** who can bring all of this together.


As BID Manager for Public 360° in Sweden, you will play a central role in our growth journey. You will lead complex public-sector tenders from early qualification and bid strategy through proposal development, submission and handover.


Working closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Legal, Security, Delivery and other specialists, you will bring the right people together, create structure around complex requirements and help turn opportunities into compelling, compliant and competitive proposals. This cross-functional ownership is also central to the existing BID Manager profile.  

  



**Your role**


* Lead and coordinate **public procurement and tender processes** from qualification and planning through submission and handover.
* Devlop clear bid strategies, timelines, responsibilities and win themes for each opportunity.
* Analyse tender documentation and requirements to ensure a strong understanding of customer needs, evaluation criteria, risks and dependencies.
* Coordinate contributions from Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Legal, Security, Delivery and other subject-matter experts.
* Translate complex technical, commercial and operational input into **clear, persuasive and customer-focused proposals**.
* Ensure bids meet formal requirements, deadlines and quality standards.
* Challenge and support internal stakeholders to strengthen our positioning and differentiate Public 360° in competitive procurements.
* Support commercial and contractual discussions together with Sales and relevant specialists.
* Facilitate reviews and lessons learned to continuously improve our bid processes, content and ways of working.
* Build and maintain reusable bid content, templates and best practices that make future tender processes more efficient.

This reflects the existing internal profile, where the BID Manager owns the process from qualification and planning through submission and handover.  

  



**Who are you?**


You are a structured and commercially minded bid professional who knows how to create clarity when the process around you is complex.


You understand that a successful public-sector bid is not simply about meeting every requirement. It is about understanding the customer, developing a clear strategy and bringing together the right expertise to create a proposal that is both **compliant and compelling**.


**We believe you bring:**


* Several years of experience within **BID Management, Proposal Management, tender management or public procurement**.
* Experience leading complex tenders, preferably within **software, SaaS, IT services or digital transformation**.
* Strong knowledge of the **Swedish public sector and public procurement processes**.
* Experience navigating formal tender requirements and coordinating complex responses involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to create structure, ownership and momentum under tight deadlines.
* Excellent writing and communication skills with the ability to turn complex information into clear and convincing proposals.
* Commercial and contractual awareness and the ability to identify risks, dependencies and opportunities.
* Confidence working across functions and influencing stakeholders without necessarily having direct authority.
* Fluency in **Swedish** and professional proficiency in **English**, both written and spoken.

Experience within case management, document management, ECM or digital solutions for the public sector is considered an advantage. These elements are also specifically reflected in the existing internal BID Manager draft.  

  



**As a person**


You are organised, proactive and accountable.


You stay calm when deadlines are tight and several workstreams are moving at the same time. You know when to dig into the details and when to step back and keep the bigger picture in focus.


You communicate clearly, create alignment and are comfortable challenging colleagues constructively when it strengthens the final proposal.


Most importantly, you take pride in creating high-quality bids and enjoy the feeling of bringing a complex process together as **one team working towards one goal: winning the right business.**

  

**What we offer**


At Public 360°, you will have the opportunity to take a central role in how we grow in the Swedish market and compete for some of the most important digitalisation initiatives within the public sector.


**You can expect:**


* A key role in Public 360°'s continued growth in Sweden.
* The opportunity to work with solutions that support the digitalisation of public services and society.
* Close collaboration with skilled colleagues across Sales, Product, Solution Consulting, Legal, Security and Delivery.
* A high level of trust, responsibility and influence over how we approach and win strategic opportunities.
* A Nordic and international working environment with strong professional networks and opportunities for development.

Flexibility and the possibility of hybrid working.  
* 

**Ready to shape our next winning bid?**


If you enjoy bringing people, strategy and complex requirements together, and want to help shape how Public 360° grows in the Swedish public sector, **we would love to hear from you.**


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

  

  

Additional Information  

  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. title: Data Architect - Global Data & Analytics Platform
description:
*Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.*

 *As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.*

 **About the job**


As a Data Architect, you will shape the future architecture of Alfa Laval’s Global Data & Analytics Platform. You will work across business domains, source systems, data products and technical teams to create a connected, scalable and governed data landscape. Combining strategic architecture with hands-on data modelling, you will assess the current landscape, define the target architecture and help teams bridge the gap between the current and future states.

  

Alfa Laval’s global data landscape spans research and development, sales, service, operations, supply chain, finance, HR and sustainability, with data distributed across multiple source systems and structures. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and solution architects, data product teams, developers and platform engineers to establish common standards, models and architectural principles. Your work will make enterprise data easier to find, understand, integrate and reuse, creating a scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, digital products and AI.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Define and drive a coherent data architecture for Alfa Laval’s Global Data & Analytics Platform—creating one connected architectural direction across business domains, systems, products and value streams, including ERP, CRM and domain-specific solutions.
* Establish and promote common architectural principles, standards and guardrails for data modelling, governance, integration, interoperability, security, quality, scalability and reuse across the platform.
* Shape the target architecture and roadmap by assessing the current landscape, identifying gaps and dependencies, and defining practical steps towards a unified future state.
* Create and maintain consistent, reusable data models across business domains, supporting common definitions and enabling data to be used across multiple analytics and business use cases.
* Translate business requirements into enterprise-level data architecture, ensuring that data products and platform capabilities align with the overall architecture rather than creating isolated solutions.
* Work hands-on with architects, data engineers and developers to implement data models, integration patterns and shared platform capabilities.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align priorities, explain architectural decisions, resolve trade-offs and build support across organizational boundaries.
* Collaborate with other architects and evaluate technologies to ensure the platform can support future analytics, AI and digital business needs.

 **Who are you**


You are a strategic and hands-on data architect who is comfortable working with ambiguity, navigating complex organizations and making decisions with incomplete information. You are pragmatic and structured, with a focus on implementable outcomes and long-term business value. Rather than creating isolated solutions, you are motivated by building reusable capabilities that can support the organization over time. You are curious and forward-looking, while remaining grounded in practical delivery.

  

You build strong working relationships with business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with people at different levels and in different disciplines. You explain complex architectural topics clearly and practically, facilitate discussions, create alignment across organizational silos, and use communication and influencing skills to drive change. You are collaborative and approachable, while also being prepared to constructively challenge existing assumptions and approaches when this helps create better outcomes across a global, matrixed organization.

 **What you know**


To succeed in this role, you bring strong experience in data architecture and modelling, combined with the technical expertise needed to shape and implement scalable cloud-based data platforms. We believe you have:

* At least five years of experience in data architecture, enterprise data architecture, data platform architecture or a related senior data role.
* Proven experience designing and implementing modern cloud-based data and analytics architectures in enterprise environments, preferably using Microsoft Azure and Azure data services.
* Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including translating business requirements into data architecture and implementable data models.
* Ability to balance platform standardization with domain autonomy, enabling reusable data products while supporting business-specific needs.
* Experience designing data integration, transformation and orchestration solutions, including enterprise integration patterns and cross-system data flows.
* Experience defining target architecture, architectural principles, standards and implementation roadmaps.
* Experience working with enterprise data platforms, data products, including data mesh or similar distributed data concepts.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, or similar tools.
* Experience with data governance, access models, data quality, metadata management and data security.
* Experience working across multiple business domains, products or value streams.
* Experience working with both technical delivery teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

  

It is considered an advantage if you have:

* Experience working across business domains such as ERP, CRM, supply chain, finance or manufacturing.
* Experience supporting analytics, machine learning or AI use cases.
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.
* Experience in a large, global and matrixed organization.

Är du en noggrann, nyfiken och driven Finance assistent som vill utvecklas i en bred roll inom ekonomi? Trivs du i en verksamhet där du får kombinera ekonomiarbete med systemfrågor, interna processer och nära samarbete med kollegor? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.


Vi söker nu en Finance Assistent till Skånemejerier/Lactalis Nordic Shared Service Center i Malmö med stark marknadsnärvaro i Norden. Detta är en direktrekrytering med planerad start i början av december.

**Om tjänsten**
---------------

------------------

* Kundreskontra
* Löpande bokföring
* Viss fakturering
* Manuella betalningar
* Behjälplig vid bokslutsarbete
* Vara med i implementation av systembyte från Navision till M3 Cloud
* Medverkan i systemrelaterade utvecklings- och förbättringsprojekt

**Lämplig bakgrund**
--------------------


Har minst två års erfarenhet av redovisning eller ekonomiadministration samt en eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi. Du känner dig trygg i det dagliga ekonomiarbetet och har ett genuint intresse för ekonomi, processer och affärssystem.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av system som Navision, M3 eller Medius och har erfarenhet av att arbeta med PO-flöden. Du är van vid att arbeta strukturerat och trivs med att följa processer. Vi ser att du har förmågan att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och är van vid tidslinjer och deadlines.

**Personliga egenskaper**
-------------------------


Som person är du analytisk, noggrann och engagerad. Du är självgående men uppskattar samtidigt att arbeta tätt tillsammans med dina kollegor. Vi tror också att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs i en producerande miljö där tempot stundtals kan vara högt. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha god systemvana samt kunna kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska.

**Vad erbjuder vi**
-------------------


Skånemejerier är det ledande mejeriföretaget i södra Sverige, en utmanare nationellt och en del av världens största mejerikoncern Lactalis. Vi är ett företag som värnar om värdena i det närproducerade och styrkorna i att samarbeta globalt. Vägledda av ambition, engagemang och enkelhet arbetar alla våra medarbetare mot samma mål – att utveckla och producera riktigt bra mat som både smakar och gör gott. I vårt sortiment finns närproducerade mejerivaror, Sveriges mest köpta juice och ostspecialiteter från Sverige och Europa, under ett paraply av älskade och välkända varumärken.


Vår vision är att ge näring åt framtiden, och då handlar det inte bara om att erbjuda produkter som är bra för både människa, djur och miljö, utan också om att vara en hållbar arbetsplats. Vi värnar om arbetsglädje, gott ledarskap, givande samarbeten och en välkomnande, stabil och inkluderande arbetsmiljö. Redan tidigt i karriären får du möjlighet att utveckla din expertis, ta egna initiativ och påverka vår gemensamma väg framåt.


Vi har fötterna i den skånska myllan men blicken ut mot världen. Här får du tillgång till ett internationellt nätverk med 85 000 kollegor i nästan 100 länder. Beroende på vilken roll du har hos oss kan du ha utbyte med kollegor i såväl Frankrike som övriga länder. Oavsett vart din framtid bär ser vi fram emot att bli del av din resa och karriär.

**Ansökan**
-----------


Låter detta som nästa steg i din karriär? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser fram emot att höra från dig.

*På Skånemejerier arbetar vi för en säker, god och drogfri arbetsmiljö. Externa slutkandidater till tjänsten kommer därför att bli ombedda att presentera ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret, genomföra ett drogtest samt i förekommande fall erbjudas hälsoundersökning på vår Företagshälsovård. Som en del i vårt förebyggande arbete så genomför vi kontinuerligt slumpvisa alkohol och drogtester.*

title: Thesis Work -Active Vision for AI-based Robot Manipulation with a 2-DOF Movable Camera Head
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Center Lead **Your role and responsibilities**

  

In robot learning, cameras are the robot's "eyes." Most current systems use fixed cameras at static positions, which limits the field of view and the ability to observe the workspace from the best angle. A pan-tilt device is a motorized mount that can rotate the camera horizontally (pan) and vertically (tilt), giving the robot a movable "neck", similar to how humans naturally turn their head to look at objects of interest.

  

This thesis investigates whether equipping a robot with a 2-degree-of-freedom (2-DOF) movable camera head brings measurable benefits to AI-based robot manipulation, using a data-driven end-to-end AI approach such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This type of model takes camera images and language instructions as input and output robot actions directly.

  

The student will work through the full pipeline, from data collection to model deployment, supported by the ABB team at each stage. Specifically, the student is expected to:

  

* Extend the existing data collection software to support a movable head setup
* Upgrade the teleoperation system with neck control, enable a human operator to control the robot's neck during demonstration recording using an AR headset
* Collect demonstration data, record robot manipulation demonstrations with the movable head setup for one or more target tasks
* Train and evaluate AI models, train VLA or other suitable models that incorporate neck/head motion as part of the action space, and investigate the benefit of a movable head vs. fixed cameras
* Deploy the model on a real robot, configure the full deployment pipeline, including sending neck motion commands, handling synchronization between robot arms and head, and addressing control delays for real-time execution
* Compare the results with and without a movable camera.

  

The student is encouraged to propose ideas on model architecture, camera configuration (e.g., whether an additional static torso camera is needed), and evaluation strategies.

  

Details:

  

* Period: January to July, 2027
* Number of credits: 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)
* Number of students for this thesis work: One
* Location: on-site, Västerås

 **Qualifications for the role**

  

* Master's student in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or other related fields
* Strong interest in robot learning, machine learning, computer vision, or physical AI
* Programming experience in Python and familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, huggingface, LeRobot platform).
* Experience with git, docker, Unity, AR, etc is a plus.
* Experience with or interest in 3D data (depth images, point clouds) is a plus
* Hands-on experience with real robot systems is a plus but not required

 **More about us**

  

Recruiting Manager LiWei Qi, +46 73 021 2309, Supervisor: Chi Zhang, chi.zhang@se.abb.com will answer your questions.

  

Positions are filled continuously. Please apply with your CV, academic transcripts, and a cover letter in English.

  

We look forward to receiving your application!


A Future Opportunity  

Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.


We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

title: Erfaren kommunikatör sökes för tidsbegränsat uppdrag – deltid eller heltid
description:
**Om Skyddsvärnet – anno 1910**
-------------------------------


Skyddsvärnet är en idéburen organisation som sedan 1910 har arbetat för att människor ska få en andra chans. Genom våra verksamheter stöttar vi människor på vägen mot ett självständigt liv, förebygger social utslagning och skapar bättre förutsättningar för inkludering.


Nu söker vi en erfaren kommunikatör för ett tidsbegränsat uppdrag med omgående start till och med mars 2027. Vi är flexibla kring tjänstgöringsgrad och välkomnar både dig som söker ett deltidsuppdrag och dig som vill arbeta heltid. Det viktigaste är att du har rätt erfarenhet och snabbt kan komma in i rollen.

**Om uppdraget**
----------------


Vi söker dig som är en erfaren och självgående kommunikatör som med kort startsträcka kan ta ansvar för våra prioriterade kommunikationsinsatser under en begränsad period.


Uppdraget är både operativt och samordnande, med fokus på att upprätthålla vår löpande kommunikation och driva ett antal viktiga kommunikationsaktiviteter framåt.


Du arbetar självständigt och i nära samarbete med organisationens chefer och verksamheter. Du rapporterar till ekonomi- och kanslichef.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------------------------

* Planera, samordna och producera Skyddsvärnets verksamhetsberättelse samt bidra med kommunikationsinnehåll till årsredovisningen.
* Planera, producera och publicera innehåll i våra sociala medier.
* Ansvara för löpande uppdateringar och innehåll på vår webbplats.
* Producera och samordna nyhetsbrev, digitala utskick och annan relevant kommunikation.
* Samarbeta med våra enhetschefer kring kommunikationsbehov, prioriteringar och strategisk kommunikationsplanering.
* Ta fram informations- och marknadsföringsmaterial vid behov.
* Vara ett stöd till organisationens chefer i interna och externa kommunikationsfrågor.


Arbetsuppgifterna prioriteras och anpassas utifrån uppdragets omfattning och tjänstgöringsgrad.

**Vi söker dig som**
--------------------


Du är en trygg och erfaren kommunikatör som är van att arbeta självständigt och snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter. Du har lätt för att identifiera vad som behöver prioriteras och trivs med att kombinera operativt kommunikationsarbete med samordning och planering.


Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Flera års erfarenhet av kommunikationsarbete.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Erfarenhet av att producera innehåll för webbplats, sociala medier och digitala utskick.
* Erfarenhet av att samordna och producera verksamhetsberättelser, årsredovisningar eller liknande publikationer.
* God vana av digitala publiceringsverktyg och Microsoft 365.
* Förmåga att självständigt planera, prioritera och genomföra kommunikationsinsatser.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av WordPress, Apsis och Adobe Creative Cloud samt tidigare har arbetat inom idéburen eller samhällsorienterad verksamhet.


Som person är du strukturerad, prestigelös, lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ. Du är van att samarbeta med olika funktioner och har förmågan att snabbt omsätta behov till konkreta kommunikationsinsatser.

**Vi erbjuder**
---------------


Hos Skyddsvärnet får du ett meningsfullt och varierat uppdrag i en organisation med stort samhällsengagemang. Du får möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet och bidra till att vår kommunikation fortsätter vara relevant, tydlig och välfungerande.


Du arbetar nära våra verksamheter och får stor frihet att planera ditt arbete utifrån uppdragets prioriteringar.


Vårt huvudkontor ligger på Barnhusgatan vid Hötorget i centrala Stockholm. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till visst hybridarbete enligt överenskommelse.

**Omfattning och ansökan**
--------------------------

* Uppdragsperiod: Omgående till och med den 31 mars 2027.
* Omfattning: Deltid eller heltid enligt överenskommelse.
* Placering: Barnhusgatan, Stockholm, med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
* Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning. Vi är även öppna för konsultlösningar.
* Tillträde: Så snart som möjligt.


Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer vi begära utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret.


Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.


Välkommen med din ansökan till Skyddsvärnet!

title: GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product
description:
**Company Description**  

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**  

The GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product is responsible for driving the global go-to-market (GTM) success of IFS's Optimisation portfolio — Planning & Scheduling Optimization (PSO), Manufacturing Scheduling & Optimization (MSO), and the What-If Scenario Explorer (WISE). Acting as the commercial and proposition owner across these offerings, this role works across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to define the GTM strategy, build the proposition, and accelerate pipeline growth and strategic deal execution.


This is a cross-portfolio role rather than a single-product sales role. AI is a collection of capabilities spanning machine learning through to agentic and frontier large language models, and the Optimisation portfolio completes that stack: PSO, MSO, and WISE apply machine learning to autonomous scheduling, planning, and predictive decisioning, increasingly integrated with agentic and frontier AI approaches to extend what customers can do with them. The AI Optimisation GTM Lead is responsible for defining the strategy and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE within this broader AI stack: how optimisation, scheduling, and predictive modeling combine to help customers make better decisions, faster, with less manual effort. The role owns the offering GTM plan, faces off directly to the product teams, and carries a number for the portfolio.


Success in this role is measured through pipeline generation, proposition and GTM adoption, strategic deal influence, and overall commercial performance of the Optimisation portfolio.

  

Key Responsibilities


Portfolio Strategy & Proposition

* Own and execute the global GTM strategy for the Optimisation portfolio (PSO, MSO, WISE), ensuring alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partners.
* Act as the commercial owner and cross-portfolio AI strategist for Optimisation, defining the common theme and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE as a single proposition rather than three disconnected products.
* Face off directly to the product teams to shape roadmap priorities, packaging, and monetisation based on market and customer feedback.
* Develop and continuously refine repeatable GTM motions that accelerate market penetration and revenue growth across the portfolio.


Sales Plays & Commercial Strategy

* Define, launch, and optimise high-impact sales plays for PSO, MSO, and WISE — individually and as a combined optimisation proposition.
* Build commercial motions that enable both standalone Optimisation opportunities and attach opportunities alongside IFS Cloud and adjacent AI offerings such as Nexus Black and IFS.ai.
* Identify market opportunities, competitive positioning, and customer use cases across field service, high-tech and discrete manufacturing, and scenario planning.
* Continuously evaluate sales performance and refine GTM approaches based on market feedback and commercial outcomes.


Strategic Deal Leadership

* Personally support and influence the company's largest global Optimisation opportunities, including the top strategic standalone deals.
* Partner with regional sales leaders throughout complex sales cycles to improve deal quality, competitive positioning, and win rates.
* Facilitate executive engagement and cross-functional collaboration for strategic pursuits.
* Capture and share best practices from major opportunities to improve repeatability across the organisation.


Pipeline Growth & Revenue Enablement

* Drive a sustainable pipeline strategy targeting a minimum four-times pipeline coverage against revenue objectives for the Optimisation portfolio.
* Partner with Marketing to develop and execute demand generation campaigns that create qualified pipeline for PSO, MSO, and WISE.
* Monitor pipeline health, campaign effectiveness, and conversion metrics, recommending corrective actions where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve pipeline quality, sales velocity, and forecast accuracy.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Product Management across PSO, MSO, and WISE to ensure market feedback influences product direction and roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Marketing to create compelling messaging, customer stories, thought leadership, and campaign content that articulate the Optimisation portfolio's AI narrative.
* Collaborate with Sales Enablement to develop training, playbooks, and sales resources that increase field effectiveness.
* Support Partner teams with GTM strategies that expand market reach through the ecosystem.


Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

* Define and monitor key commercial performance metrics across pipeline generation, win rates, deal progression, and GTM effectiveness for the portfolio.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership, including the AI Business Unit, on market performance, strategic opportunities, and execution priorities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve execution, and increase commercial impact.

**Success Measures**


Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Delivery of global GTM campaigns that generate measurable pipeline growth across PSO, MSO, and WISE.
* Achievement of at least a 4x pipeline multiple against commercial targets.
* Growth in standalone Optimisation revenue alongside increased IFS Cloud attachment rates.
* Establishment of a single, coherent Optimisation portfolio narrative and proposition across PSO, MSO, and WISE.
* Successful support and influence of the company's top strategic Optimisation opportunities globally.
* Increased adoption of Optimisation sales plays across global sales teams.
* Improved win rates, pipeline conversion, and commercial predictability.
* Strong cross-functional alignment that accelerates market execution and customer adoption.

 **Qualifications**  

Qualifications & Experience

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or technology organisations within Go-to-Market, Product Marketing, Sales Strategy, Business Development, or related commercial roles.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing global GTM strategies for enterprise software products, ideally spanning multiple products or a portfolio.
* Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and influencing strategic customer opportunities.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales motions, including pipeline generation, solution selling, and partner ecosystems.
* Experience working across multiple business functions including Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership.
* Domain knowledge of optimisation, scheduling, or planning technologies is highly advantageous — for example, field service planning and scheduling optimisation (PSO), manufacturing scheduling and digital-twin-based planning (MSO), or scenario modeling and predictive analytics (WISE / what-if analysis).
* Familiarity with the full spectrum of AI capabilities, from machine learning through to agentic and frontier AI approaches, and the ability to translate technical AI capability into a clear commercial proposition.
* Knowledge of Field Service Management, Enterprise Asset Management, Manufacturing, ERP, Industrial AI, or enterprise business applications is advantageous.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline. MBA is beneficial.

  

Skills & Competencies

* Commercial mindset with strong business and revenue acumen.
* Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to influence senior executives and global sales organisations without direct authority.
* Ability to translate complex AI, optimisation, and scheduling concepts into clear, customer-facing propositions.
* Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.
* Data-driven decision making with the ability to translate insights into commercial action.
* Strong project and program management capabilities.
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced, global, and matrixed environments.
* Passion for building repeatable GTM motions that drive measurable business outcomes.

 **Additional Information** *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

**Om tjänsten**
  

Vill du arbeta brett inom Microsofts molntjänster och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla smartare och mer automatiserade IT-lösningar? Vi på Maxitech söker nu en IT Operations & Cloud Platform Engineer till vår kund NTT Security i Göteborg.


NTT Security är ett internationellt bolag inom cybersäkerhet med en tekniskt avancerad verksamhet och ett nära samarbete mellan sina team i Sverige och Japan. I samband med organisatoriska förändringar har den svenska verksamheten fått ett utökat ansvar för bolagets interna Microsoft- och Azuremiljö. Därför söker NTT nu en ny kollega som vill ta ett stort operativt ansvar och vara med och vidareutveckla IT-miljön.


Rollen passar en person med erfarenhet av Microsoft 365, Azure och IT-drift som vill kombinera teknisk problemlösning med automation och förbättringsarbete. Kanske arbetar du idag som IT Infrastructure Specialist, Microsoft 365 Engineer eller Cloud Operations Engineer och söker en roll med större ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.


Här blir du en del av ett mindre team där arbetsuppgifterna varierar mellan daglig drift, teknisk support och mer långsiktigt utvecklingsarbete. Det finns goda möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt och hur rollen utvecklas över tid.

En viktig del av rollen är att vidareutveckla automatiserade arbetsflöden, exempelvis inom onboarding och offboarding, där flera processer redan idag hanteras genom automation i Azure. Du förväntas kunna sätta sig in i befintliga lösningar, förstå hur systemen samverkar och identifiera möjligheter till förbättring.

* Utveckla och förbättra automatiserade processer med exempelvis PowerShell och Microsoft Graph

* Samarbeta med kollegor i Sverige och Japan kring drift, utveckling och förvaltning av den globala IT-miljön

Vi söker en person med praktisk erfarenhet av Microsofts molntjänster och ett intresse för att utveckla effektiva och hållbara IT-lösningar. Du behöver ha en god teknisk grund och känna sig bekväm med att arbeta självständigt i befintliga IT-miljöer.

* Kunskap inom Microsoft Intune eller motsvarande lösningar för klienthantering
* Erfarenhet av IT-drift, teknisk felsökning och användarsupport
* Erfarenhet av, eller god förståelse för, PowerShell, scripting och automation
* Grundläggande förståelse för IT-säkerhet, exempelvis MFA, Conditional Access och endpoint security
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av Microsoft Graph, Linuxadministration, serverdrift eller on-premise-infrastruktur. Relevanta Microsoftcertifieringar är också ett plus, men inget krav.


För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och har ett genuint intresse för teknik. NTT Security värdesätter framför allt eget driv och viljan att förstå hur saker fungerar, snarare än att redan från början kunna allt.


Eftersom teamet är litet är det viktigt att du är prestigelös och uppskattar en varierad arbetsvardag, där enklare supportärenden kan varvas med mer avancerade tekniska utmaningar. Rollen passar någon som gärna tar initiativ, identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och driver arbetet framåt.


Samtidigt är samarbetsförmåga och kommunikation avgörande. Du behöver trivas med att dela kunskap, diskutera lösningar och samarbeta med kollegor i olika delar av organisationen.


**Övrigt**

title: Thesis Work -Depth-Aware Physical AI Models for Robot Manipulation
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Center Lead **Your role and responsibilities**

  

Physical AI models such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising approach to robot automation. Unlike traditional robot programming, VLA models learn robot manipulation tasks directly from human demonstrations. They take camera images and language instructions as input, and output robot actions directly. Currently, most VLA models rely solely on standard RGB (color) images, which lack explicit spatial and geometric information about the environment.

  

This thesis investigates how to incorporate depth information (e.g., from RGB-D cameras) into VLA or other physical AI models to improve robot manipulation performance.

  

The student is expected to:

  

* Survey existing approaches for integrating depth/3D information into VLA or other physical AI robot manipulation policies
* Design and implement one or more methods to incorporate depth into a VLA or other physical AI model (e.g., as an additional input modality, via 3D representations, or point clouds, etc)
* Evaluate performance on real robot manipulation tasks in ABB's lab environment
* Document findings and contribute to ABB's Physical AI pipeline

  

The student is encouraged to propose their own ideas on how depth information can best be represented and utilized within the model.

  

Details:

  

* Period: January to July, 2027
* Number of credits: 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng (hp)
* Number of students for this thesis work: 1
* Location: on-site, Västerås

 **Qualifications for the role**

  

* Master's student in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or other related fields
* Strong interest in robot learning, machine learning, computer vision, or physical AI
* Programming experience in Python and familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, huggingface, LeRobot platform).
* Experience with git, docker, etc is a plus.
* Experience with or interest in 3D data (depth images, point clouds) is a plus
* Hands-on experience with real robot systems is a plus but not required
* Ability to work independently and communicate findings clearly

 **More about us**

  

Recruiting Manager LiWei Qi, +46 73 021 2309, Supervisor: Chi Zhang, chi.zhang@se.abb.com , Marco Iannotta marco.iannotta@se.abb.com will answer your questions.

  

Positions are filled continuously. Please apply with your CV, academic transcripts, and a cover letter in English.

  

We look forward to receiving your application!


A Future Opportunity  

Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.


We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.
