title: Generative AI Specialist
description:
**Are you excited by the move from chatbots to reliable, production-grade AI agents? Do you enjoy turning emerging AI capabilities into customer experiences that are useful, safe, measurable, and genuinely scalable?**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================

  

  

Join the Generators squad in If’s Oasis tribe and help shape the next generation of digital customer experiences in insurance.

  

  

Our GenAI-powered assistant is live across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway, serving customers on web and app. Now we are expanding across the Nordics and evolving the assistant from a strong conversational experience into a more personalized, connected, and action-oriented AI product.

  

  

You will be central to that journey, working on real production systems with a modern stack (LangGraph, Langfuse, Azure): designing, building, evaluating, and operating AI systems that can use internal knowledge and APIs responsibly to help customers get the right guidance at the right moment.

  

  

**About the role**
------------------

This is one open position, and we are open to both junior and senior candidates. As our Generative AI Specialist, you will be a hands-on engineer in the Generators squad, building production AI systems alongside the team, from agent design and retrieval to evaluation and monitoring.

  

  

Your responsibilities include:


* Designing and building production-grade agentic workflows with tool and API use, orchestration, guardrails, and safe handover paths.
* Building the agent harness: the runtime that makes agents dependable in production, including context management, memory, and observability.
* Scaling our AI assistant across Nordic markets.
* Integrating AI systems with internal APIs and data to deliver personalized support.
* Improving retrieval, grounding, and response quality through systematic experimentation.
* Establishing evaluation practices (test sets, regression testing, human and safety evaluation) and monitoring quality, latency, and cost.
* Building improvement loops that use evaluations, customer feedback, and production signals.
* Collaborating with the Product Owner and the team through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  

  

We have a hybrid setup with fixed team days onsite. Occasional travel to Nordic markets and our Kuala Lumpur office is part of the role.

  

  

**We offer**
------------

Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


* An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities and a highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of a hybrid workplace
* A health-promoting workplace with e.g., fitness programs and various sports activities
* Attractive insurance benefits
  

  

**About the team**
------------------

You will be a hands-on squad member in Generators, an agile team that builds customer-facing solutions driven by real user insights. We work with a clear build, measure, learn mindset and continuously validate what creates the most value for our customers.

  

  

Collaboration, code quality, and a team-first mindset matter deeply to us. You will work closely with colleagues across engineering, product, and business to turn ambitious AI opportunities into reliable customer experiences. Junior colleagues are supported by experienced teammates through pairing and code reviews, and seniors help shape the team’s direction.

  

  

**Who are you?**
----------------

You are an engineer, at junior or senior level, who is curious about AI and enjoys building, testing, and improving systems in production. You are a team player who is pragmatic, unafraid to challenge assumptions, and thrives in a cross-Nordic, cross-functional, hybrid environment.

  

  

Must have (all levels):


* A university degree in a technical or quantitative field, such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, mathematical economics, physics, or statistics.
* Hands-on Python experience, ideally with FastAPI, Pydantic, and pytest.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications, ideally with LangGraph or LangChain, and sound knowledge of agentic best practices: tool use, orchestration, state management, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, and safe fallbacks.
* Experience with AI evaluations (test sets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge) and observability of LLM applications (we use Langfuse).
* Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Docker, and cloud, ideally Azure.
* The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders.
  

  

Senior level / nice to have:


* Proven experience running LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, including cost, latency, and incident management.
* Knowledge of RAG: embeddings, vector search (we use Qdrant), reranking, and grounding.
* Experience designing an agent harness or comparable runtime: context management, memory, access control, and safe deployment.
* Azure (OpenAI or AI Foundry, Key Vault, App Configuration), infrastructure as code with Bicep, and secure API design.
* Data and platform services such as Redis, MongoDB, and Qdrant, and tracing with Langfuse, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry.
* Mentoring colleagues and shaping technical direction.
  

  

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis. The deadline to apply is 01.12.2026.
  

**Application:** Please submit your CV via our website. You do not need to attach a cover letter, instead answer the questions in the recruiting system.
  

**Location:** Denmark (Copenhagen) or Finland (Turku or Espoo).
  

**Start date:** As soon as possible.

  

  

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact GenAI Chapter Lead, Petr Vanek at mobile +45 31256617 or e-mail petr.vanek@if.dk.

  

  

*At If, we aim to create a workplace with equal opportunities for all. We encourage everyone to apply regardless of gender, age, background, or any disability. We also recommend that you do not include a photo in your CV.*

  

Applicant information may, within the framework of the law, be reviewed using publicly available sources. Candidates progressing in the recruitment process will be asked to provide references and present a criminal record certificate. Depending on the scope of the role, a credit check may also be conducted for final candidates as part of the hiring process.

  

  

We look forward to your application!

You will work closely with process owners, business stakeholders, and operational teams across SKF to develop capabilities and implement global standards and ways of working.

  

**What you can expect in the role**

* Translate business requirements into scalable process and solution designs with a strong fit-to-standard mindset.
* Contribute to planning template governance, testing, deployment, training and stabilisation.

**SAP IBP and planning**

**What we are looking for**

* Experience with SAP IBP in implementation, process/solution design or business support.
* Solid understanding of Supply Chain Planning and its business impact.
* Experience from transformation programmes, ERP implementations or planning solution deployments.
* Experience working in international, cross-functional environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology.
* Fluent English.

title: Cloud & Compute Research Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About the Opportunity**

  

The Lund section of Research Area Compute and Software is a team of 11 working on distributed systems, reliability, real-time computing and standardization. We operate a state-of-the-art OpenStack cloud and compute environment used around the clock by hundreds of Ericsson and academic users. It is both a reliable service and our primary research testbed.

  

You will bridge systems operations and academic inquiry: keep the infrastructure performant and reliable through daily operations while contributing to research on cloud architectures, virtualization, AI-driven operations (AIOps) and software execution environments. You will use operational challenges to inform research, and hands-on experiments and prototypes to evaluate new system concepts. The role calls for practical engineering, debugging and active systems management alongside scientific curiosity—not theory alone.

 **What You Will Do**

* Operate and evolve the OpenStack cloud and compute environment used by Ericsson and academic researchers.
* Troubleshoot complex distributed systems, investigate root causes, and help ensure reliable services.
* Design, prototype and evaluate system concepts, software execution environments, performance and reliability.
* Contribute to and drive research studies in compute systems, cloud architectures, virtualization and AIOps, including collaboration on scientific publications.
* Automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows and scale infrastructure; work across operations, engineering and research to turn practical challenges into real-world solutions.
 **The Skills You Bring**

* A research-oriented degree, such as a Ph.D., or equivalent experience in a research-intensive role.
* Demonstrated research contribution in compute, cloud virtualization or software systems, for example through publications, patents, technical reports or working prototypes.
* Hands-on Linux administration and systems engineering experience, with a solid understanding of cloud technologies, Kubernetes, data-center operations and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with containers (Docker or Podman) and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Ability to research, instrument and maintain compute environments with AI capabilities supporting workflows, monitoring and intelligent observability.
* A hands-on “doer” mindset; analytical and scientific curiosity; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis; and a drive to automate and improve workflows.
* Strong collaboration skills across operational, engineering and research teams.
* It is an advantage to bring or develop skills in Ansible, Terraform or Helm; advanced OpenStack operations; HPC or accelerators (GPUs, DPUs or FPGAs); and research collaboration or patenting processes.
